title: Integer To Roman
description:
Convert the integer `num` to its Roman numeral representation. Use the standard symbols `I`, `V`, `X`, `L`, `C`, `D`, and `M`, including subtractive forms `IV`, `IX`, `XL`, `XC`, `CD`, and `CM`.

## Examples

```text
Input: num = 3749
Output: "MMMDCCXLIX"
```

```text
Input: num = 58
Output: "LVIII"
```

```text
Input: num = 1994
Output: "MCMXCIV"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= num <= 3999`
